comment: The draft's implicit care model is episodic and programme-centric (HIV, TB, immunisation examples). Across 254 pages, 'integrated care', 'social care' and 'long-term care' do not appear; 'caregiver' appears once; 'chronic' four times. The person with multiple chronic conditions whose care spans health and social services over years — precisely the population that most needs shared infrastructure — is absent as a design case.
